government_groups_citation.claim: After the September 2022 election, ANO 2011 (which won, 12 seats, lídr Jan Nadrchal) formed a three-party governing coalition with Žijeme Pardubice (ŽP, 4 seats) and Společně pro Pardubice (SpP, 4 seats) — 20 of 39 mandates, the narrowest possible majority. Coalition agreement signed 2022-10-14; constitutive session 2022-10-17; Jan Nadrchal (ANO 2011) elected primátor. SPOLU (ODS + TOP 09 + KDU-ČSL) went into opposition, alongside Piráti, NAŠE PARDUBICE and SPD.

The ANO 2011 + ŽP + SpP coalition held for the whole 2022-2026 term — no coalition breakdown or crisis was reported (searched 2026-08-31) — and the same three movements signed a coalition agreement to continue together after the 2026 election.

Cross-check against this repo's own derived data (pardubice/data/memberships.csv from party_affiliation.py): the deputy-mayors named in the news — Jakub Rychtecký (ŽP), René Živný (SpP), Jan Hrabal (ANO 2011), Jiřina Klčová (ANO 2011) — each map to a councillor whose klub interval matches the claimed coalition party for the whole term, and the SpP/ŽP klubs are contiguous from the term's start with no defection out of them.
